auditChecks.name: Missing months
auditChecks.detail: Every month from January through August and September 1–4 is represented.

auditChecks.name: Source categories
auditChecks.detail: Each designated category was searched for every covered month; source-level last-checked dates are in the registry.

auditChecks.name: Modality balance
auditChecks.detail: Blood, CSF comparison, amyloid PET, and tau PET were explicitly searched; zero qualifying items are retained as zero rather than backfilled with filler.

auditChecks.name: Regulatory and recall actions
auditChecks.detail: FDA 510(k), drug approval, and recall databases were screened.

auditChecks.name: Coverage and coding
auditChecks.detail: CMS, MAC, CLFS, private-payer policy, and public PLA/CPT references were screened; policy is not conflated with payment.

auditChecks.name: Deduplication
auditChecks.detail: DOI, PMID, trial, FDA, recall, and organization identifiers were used; abstracts and releases were merged into definitive records.
